📦 Project 1: Go-Backend Multi-Stage Distroless Docker Build

Designed a highly optimized multi-stage build that compiles a Golang backend inside a build container, strips out all non-runtime binary dependencies, and ships it inside a secure, attack-surface-free distroless image file to protect system compute layers.

FROM golang:1.23-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o /app/backend-engine .

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:latest
WORKDIR /
COPY --from=builder /app/backend-engine /backend-engine
EXPOSE 5000
USER 65532:65532
ENTRYPOINT ["/backend-engine"]

🧱 Project 2: Terraform Multi-AZ Private Subnet & ALB Blueprint

Automated a resilient single-VPC architecture spanning multiple Availability Zones using Terraform. Provisions network routes, configures Public ALBs, maps Nginx reverse proxy routing targets, and links Private ALBs to application Auto Scaling Target Groups.

resource "aws_lb" "private_alb" {
  name               = "private-internal-alb"
  internal           = true 
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.private_alb_sg.id]
  subnets            = [aws_subnet.private_az1.id, aws_subnet.private_az2.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "backend_app_tg" {
  name        = "private-backend-target-group"
  port        = 5000 
  protocol    = "HTTP"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main_vpc.id
  target_type = "instance"
}

🔄 Project 3: Zero-Downtime ASG Rolling Update GitOps Pipeline

Programmed an automated GitHub Actions pipeline. Triggered by repository commits, it manages syntax verification, runs testing modules, handles remote AWS registry uploads, and invokes native Auto Scaling Group Instance Refreshes for zero-downtime rolling updates.

- name: Build, Tag, and Push Secure Docker Image
  run: |
    docker build -t $ECR_REGISTRY/$ECR_REPOSITORY:$IMAGE_TAG .
    docker push $ECR_REGISTRY/$ECR_REPOSITORY:$IMAGE_TAG

- name: Trigger ASG Zero-Downtime Instance Rolling Update
  run: |
    aws autoscaling start-instance-refresh \
      --auto-scaling-group-name prod-backend-asg \
      --preferences '{"MinHealthyPercentage": 50}'
